intel.claim: o9 sells an enterprise planning platform, the Digital Brain, built on a digital twin of the supply chain network.
intel.detail: Their retail planning covers assortment optimisation, allocation planning and markdown optimisation. Revenue Growth Management covers price, promotion and trade spend optimisation.
intel.source: IA_with_o9_Solutions.docx, under "1.3 Product Offering"
intel.author: Competitive Marketing

intel.claim: o9 claims markdown, assortment, allocation, price and promotion optimisation as shipped capabilities.

intel.source: IA_with_o9_Solutions.docx, under "1.3 Product Offering"
intel.author: Competitive Marketing

intel.claim: o9 sells across seven verticals, so retail is one industry of several rather than the whole company.
intel.detail: Retail, consumer products, high tech, life sciences, automotive, energy and resources, industrial manufacturing. That breadth is a strength in a global enterprise, and the opening for a retail specialist everywhere else.
intel.source: IA_with_o9_Solutions.docx, under "1.2 Target Market & Market Share"
intel.author: Competitive Marketing

intel.claim: Ask which of their seven verticals the implementation team behind your proposal has actually delivered in.
intel.detail: Breadth across industries is their strength and also the question worth asking, since a retail programme staffed from another vertical is a different risk.
intel.source: IA_with_o9_Solutions.docx, under "1.2 Target Market & Market Share"
